Plus, track all scores and results from the Women's Nations League and Women's European Qualifiers, as they build towards EURO 2025 in Switzerland. 

With the official app, you won’t miss a kick!

- Check the full match schedule for the men's European Qualifiers, plus the Women's Nations League and European Qualifiers
- Get live minute-by-minute updates from every single match
- Don’t miss a single goal thanks to real-time push notifications
- Review the goals in detail with next-day highlights of every match
- Watch interviews with players
- View all fixtures and results
- Explore in-depth stats and form guides for each team
- Analyse individual team pages, squads and player pages
- Check the latest live scores and group standings
- Get a heads-up with notifications for all goals, kick-offs, confirmed line-ups and draws
- Follow the latest soccer news, scores and videos
- Personalise your feed by selecting the teams you’re interested in

The app is available in English, French, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. 

Download the official UEFA EURO 2024 & Women's EURO 2025 app today and enjoy the best of men's and women’s European international soccer!
